additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431822-DC/Si-D/CZ- [ MP / R3 170001596] Unexpected interruptions CRM:02832000095
additional_info.body:
Dear Michal Jurajda,
Hope you are doing well.
I had a quick look at the charger behavior over the month (from 1st June 2025), and these are my findings:
#30 activation of the error flag “
PLC-Error-Flag 'DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101' changed to true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)”, where:
VIV:0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
PLE:1→ in case of a plausibility error
KON:1: → in case the contact temperature sensors are not okay
Since then, no other appearance of the error flag. The issue is therefore not permanent and not recurring daily.
I do not see at the moment a clear reason to replace the cable. What can be done is to go onsite and check the plug. In particular, please check the status of the pins of the plug and the connector mating surface. Please check if dust or dirt is inside the fins of the plug, or if the fins are bent/broken. All these points might reduce the contact surface or create hotspots, resulting in CableTempSensor issue.
Additionally, the charger is showing in the old version v6.0, so we can get significant improvements by updating the charger to the latest update. After upgrading the latest one, we will analyze whether the problem still exists or not.
So, could you please ask the customer if it can be update with the latest firmware version and if yes then let us know the date and time so that we can proceed further to upgrade it.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

Today, we were on site and found the issue.
The problem is with the loose cable at the end of the connector. That is most likely the reason why we get 'DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101' and the session is interrupted.
